correctness.rationale: The universal proof reconstructs the six monomial coefficient slots from the vanishing first-order jet. Any two absent slots impose independent coefficient rows and force a single scalar quadratic factor. Its zero must be isolated, hence definite, but its translation to a positive equilibrium has at least five nonzero monomials. Five distinct directed reactions explicitly achieve the minimum; exact symbolic row-rank and network checks are reproducible.

value.rationale: This is the exact minimum number of reactions for existence of a natural isolated positive strongly nonhyperbolic planar chemical equilibrium, directly addressing the simplicity criterion in the motivating literature. The bound is universal across geometric classes, not tied to one arbitrary parameter instance; a known matching witness proves sharpness. No theorem of greater generality or downstream application is asserted.
